ox.repository.conflicts.description: Read service source conflicts: `await ox.repository.conflicts({ purpose, service? })`. Returns up to 100 conflicts, each with service, selectedRepository (or null), and candidates with repository IDs and names. Only enabled, available repositories are candidates. If truncated, filter by the exact service identity. This includes conflicts with an already selected source. Select the source identified by the user's task; ask only when the intended source is unclear. Do not detach services or disable a repository to resolve one service conflict.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.repository.connect.description: Connect a repository: `await ox.repository.connect({ purpose, origin })`. origin is a public HTTPS Git URL or files/<grant-id>[/subfolder]. For a folder, ask the user to add it through this Profile's Files page, then list files to find its grant ID. Folder grants and mounted services belong to this Profile on this Host; no Files service attachment is needed. Mounting alone does not activate services. The root must contain a current-version repository.json. Mounted source is read in place without copying or migration; edit through files and sync to reload. Returns its ID; services and skills become available after loading.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.repository.disconnect.description: Disconnect a remote or mounted repository by ID: `await ox.repository.disconnect({ purpose, repository })`. Find its ID with ox.repository.list. Repository files and folder grants remain; remote snapshots stay in Files under Repositories. Service definitions and repository skills become unavailable; website sign-ins and data remain. Bundled, Development, and Local repositories cannot be disconnected; the runtime handles approval.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.repository.enable.description: Enable or disable an existing repository through the existing Action permission system without a separate consent prompt: `await ox.repository.enable({ purpose, repository, enabled })`. Use an exact ID from ox.repository.list. Local is always enabled and cannot be disabled. Changes the device-wide service and skill catalog without deleting source, credentials, or website state. Returns the resulting enabled state, catalog counts, and whether it changed. Disabling does not revoke existing running attachments. Failure may leave enablement saved; inspect ox.repository.list before retrying. Do not use this to resolve one source conflict.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.repository.list.description: Read sanitized summaries of Ox's repositories: `await ox.repository.list({ purpose })`. Returns at most 50 IDs, names, provenance, enabled state, load state, and service and skill counts. Use a remote or mounted repository ID with ox.repository.sync or ox.repository.disconnect. Never returns origins, filesystem paths, Git details, or credentials, and cannot change repositories.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.repository.resolve.description: Select an existing service source: `await ox.repository.resolve({ purpose, service, repository })`. Use exact IDs from ox.repository.conflicts. Persists the device-wide choice through the normal Action policy without changing repository enablement or source files. Revalidates availability before saving. Returns service, selectedRepository, and reloadRequired for this conversation. Selection refreshes the service catalog. Repair or validate Local source, then call ox.service.attach to reload this conversation and verify its repository before invoking actions.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.repository.sync.description: Refresh a remote or mounted repository in place: `await ox.repository.sync({ purpose, repository })`. Find its ID with ox.repository.list. Remote source is authoritative: sync replaces the downloaded snapshot, including local edits, without merging or keeping a copy. Mounted sync rereads the granted folder. Returns refreshed service and skill counts. Use sync rather than reconnecting; the runtime handles approval.
